note: the way out of the home region. In logged games of the new standard the main hero never leaves its corner of the map: on map 21205 it stood behind 24 centaur captains (danger 5,000) from day 1 to day 93 with an army that grew to 443,000, explored a fifth of the map and lost; on map 21201 it left 35 troglodytes standing from day 10 to day 28 and took its second town on day 30. Cause: the guard between two regions stands in a gap one tile wide, the view ends behind it, so beating it 'opens' nothing, and every day new troops at home are worth more than the guard. X = expansion as tested before (troops fetched by their share of the army, land behind a guard counted from the guard, a region behind a guard worth 8000, main hero looks 12 days ahead); P = passage: the tiles a guard watches on its far side count as land behind it, and a region counts where known land behind a guard runs on into unseen land (in the probe on 21201: out on day 7, second town on day 8); W = simulated fights against map guards (realistic losses, now that breaking out has a value). Long games on medium land maps, 24 per config, seed 48.
